bound.how: pda ingest --source aqua --limit 10. The official Akvakulturregisteret OpenAPI prints 26 paths. 10 untemplated collection GETs are /api/v1/sites, /api/v1/licenses, /api/v1/licenses-overview, /api/v1/license-types/intentions, /api/v1/fish-codes, /api/v1/entities, /api/v1/dump/xlsx-file, /api/v1/dump/new-legacy-csv, /api/v1/dump/new-legacy-csv-file, and /api/v1/areas. Templated {site-nr} / {license-nr} / {entity-nr-id} / {version-id} paths are skipped. The adapter copies the printed untemplated GET paths joined to https://api.fiskeridir.no/pub-aqua.
